==Experience rates==
Based on the rune distribution shown above, the chance of getting a specific rune is the same for 10 levels, e.g. the chance of getting a Death Rune is the exact same at level 30-39 but will increase significantly at level 40.

These experience rates assume players are using a [[rune pouch]], have all of the [[essence pouch]]es available at each level, and the [[Ourania Teleport]] spell is being used. The rates are calculated under the assumption of 48s per lap, with an additional loss of 15s per hour per pouch tier unlocked due to [[NPC Contact]]. Tick-perfect rates will be marginally (~5%) higher.

You may also expect roughly 4k Magic xp/hr from the [[Ourania Teleport]] and [[NPC Contact]] casts.
